# netbox_ipsec_profile (Resource)

Manages a NetBox IPSec profile (`/api/vpn/ipsec-profiles/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_ipsec_profile" "example" {
  name = "example"
  mode = "esp"
  ike_policy_id = netbox_ike_policy.example.id
  ipsec_policy_id = netbox_ipsec_policy.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ike_policy_id` (Number) ID of the Ike Policy (`netbox_ike_policy`).
- `ipsec_policy_id` (Number) ID of the Ipsec Policy (`netbox_ipsec_policy`).
- `mode` (String) Mode. Valid values: `esp`, `ah`.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_ipsec_profile can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_ipsec_profile.example 123
```
